description: This file defines constants, data structures, and function prototypes related to Discontinuous Transmission (DTX) in an audio codec, specifically for the AMR-WB codec's encoder side.

methods.name: dtx_enc_init
methods.description: Initializes the DTX encoder state with initial ISF values.

methods.name: dtx_enc_reset
methods.description: Resets the DTX encoder state with new ISF values.

methods.name: dtx_enc_exit
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the DTX encoder state.

methods.name: dtx_enc
methods.description: Performs DTX encoding, generating CN ISF vector and excitation.

methods.name: dtx_buffer
methods.description: Buffers residual energy and ISF data for DTX processing.

methods.name: tx_dtx_handler
methods.description: Handles DTX transmission decisions based on VAD flag.

methods.name: Qisf_ns
methods.description: Quantizes ISF in the frequency domain.
